items.Sentence: Raw wastewater is pumped to the WWRP through three main pumping stations located throughout Rancho Murieta.
Secondary treatment takes place in a series of five clay-lined aerated facultative ponds (Aeration Ponds 1 through 4).

Undisinfected secondary treated effluent is stored in two clay-lined storage reservoirs (Reservoirs 1 and 2) with a combined storage capacity of approximately 747 acre feet (AF) with 2 feet of freeboard prior to tertiary treatment and disinfection.
Solids are removed from the treatment ponds and placed on drying beds prior to offsite disposal.

Tertiary treatment and disinfection consists of two dissolved air floatation units, two rapid sand filters, a chlorine gas feed system, chlorine contact basin, and 6,600 linear feet of chlorine contact pipe installed in a concrete lined equalization basin.
